subject: Mirana discovery — SOC2, retention & evidence ask list
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@mirana-fin.com>, security@mirana-fin.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mirana discovery — SOC2, retention & evidence ask list

Hi Elena / Mirana InfoSec team,

Thanks again for the time today — appreciated the candid discussion about your retention constraints and audit requirements. Below is a concise recap from our call and a prioritized ask list so your legal and security teams can kick off review. I’ve attached a short pen-test question checklist (mirana-pen-test-asklist.pdf) for the InfoSec team to scan.

Top-level goals we heard
- Support SOC 2 compliance for production deployments (in scope: logging, access, change history)
- 7-year retention for audit logs; shorter retention for non-audit telemetry
- Clear DPA language around data use and deletion for EU/NA customers

Primary pain points
- Unclear evidence path for historical audit logs (how long logs are retained, export formats)
- Need pen-test artifacts and timeline for vendor attestations
- Tight procurement window — legal needs DPA redlines in ~2 weeks to hit procurement window

Requested evidence & asks (priority order)
1) SOC 2: high-level control mappings + auditor contact (artifact: SOC 2 Type II report or readiness summary) — deliverable: summary doc
2) Audit logs: retention policy + sample export (deliverable: log-retention-policy.md + sample .ndjson export)
3) Pen test: scope, most recent report, remediation timeline (attached asklist)
4) DPA draft: we’ll send our standard DPA; please flag redlines — we can work with your counsel.

Next steps & owners
- Mirana: confirm which artifacts you need first (Elena) — target: 2027-05-07
- Redwood: provide SOC 2 summary + retention policy + DPA draft (owner: me / karthik) — target: 2027-05-06
- Redwood Security: Marissa to pull pen-test summary and confirm any outstanding remediation windows — target: 2027-05-10

Attachments: mirana-pen-test-asklist.pdf (short checklist of pen-test artifact asks)

If this matches your notes, could you ack and tell us if procurement will need an executed DPA before vendor onboarding? We’ll prioritize accordingly.

Thanks,

-- 
Soojin Lee
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@mirana-fin.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@mirana-fin.com
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mirana discovery — SOC2, retention & evidence ask list

Thanks Soojin — that summary is spot on. A few clarifications from Mirana InfoSec:

- SOC 2: we do need a current Type II report or a written SOC-readiness summary; our auditors will want the report prior to pilot sign-off. If you can provide a redacted report that’s fine.
- Audit logs: 7-year retention for authentication and transaction logs; we will accept periodic exports in newline-delimited json but we need a documented export path and retention SLA.
- Pen test: our security ops would like the scope and remediation status; if you can confirm whether any critical findings were remediated in the last 12 months, that would help speed approval.
- DPA: procurement will require an executed DPA before moving into any production-facing onboarding. We can accept an interim DPA signature for pilot (limited access) but final production requires full DPA.

We’ll take a look at the pen-test asklist you attached and circle back with any extra requirements. For timelines — we’re aiming to get legal sign-off on pilot agreements by 2027-05-14; if Redwood can provide the SOC summary + DPA draft by 2027-05-06 that keeps us on track.

Elena

Marissa — forwarding the thread. Mirana is firm on needing a SOC2 artefact + DPA before production. They’re open to a pilot DPA but procurement wants the signed DPA pre-prod.

Action for security: can you do the following please?
- Pull the latest pen-test report and confirm remediation status for any findings in the last 12 months. If there were critical or high findings, provide remediation evidence (tickets or patch dates).
- Produce a 1-page SOC2 summary (controls in-scope, auditor name, date range, redacted report ok).
- Confirm our supported retention/export formats and draft a short export SLA snippet we can share.

Priority: we should have SOC2 summary + pen-test status and draft DPA redlines by EOD 2027-05-06 so Soojin can send to Mirana. Please cc legal if any clarifications are needed on redlines.

— Karthik
